title: alea-intake — Persona UAT Campaign (live validation)
description: First live end-to-end validation of the intake pipeline, plus fix round 2 + re-judge vs rubric v1.2. Round 1 (session 3): five deploy-test-diagnose-fix cycles took the pipeline from fully inert to end-to-end live; judged vs v1.1 at 4/6, 3/6, 3/6 gates. Round 2 (session 4): BUG-12..16 + GATE-01 + q10 fixes deployed, 3-persona re-run (runs 26/27/28), re-judged vs LOCKED v1.2 by 3 independent judges + deterministic sidecars. Deadline gates now pass where they failed (BUG-12 verified), but v1.2's semantic-fit sub-criterion and a newly-caught empty-JSON-export defect gate all three personas. Expansion not run (policy 5).
spend: app-side ~$2-3 est. total (gpt-4o-mini): session-3 runs+probes ~$1-2; session-4 3-persona re-run ~$1; re-judge round $0 app-side (judging is orchestration-side); 8-persona expansion NOT run
environment: Railway alea-intake-dev (gpt-4o-mini), commit 682039e (== master at re-run; evidence commit 5973b13)

sections.title: Campaign result — gates summary
sections.body:
Re-judge vs LOCKED rubric v1.2 (fix round 2, runs 26/27/28), session-3 v1.1 baseline in parens:
`landlord-tenant` 4/6 (was 4/6) — now fail RUB-05, RUB-15 (was 08, 09)
`immigration` 2/6 (was 3/6) — fail RUB-01, RUB-05, RUB-08, RUB-15 (was 01, 08, 09)
`family-custody` 3/6 (was 3/6) — fail RUB-01, RUB-05, RUB-15 (was 01, 08, 09)

What the fixes bought: BUG-12 WORKED — RUB-09 (deadline accuracy) now passes on all 3; RUB-08 passes on landlord-tenant + family-custody with computed dates matching the answer keys (2026-03-17, 2026-04-01, 2026-07-15, 2026-07-22) and correct 2026 year anchoring. RUB-04 (no fabrication) passes everywhere.

What now gates: (a) RUB-05 fails all 3 under v1.2's semantic-fit sub-criterion — resolvable IRIs semantically wrong, surfaced at 70-90% confidence (see BUG-21); (b) RUB-15 fails all 3 — JSON exports are empty shells vs on-screen content (see BUG-18; latent since round 1, PDFs are complete); (c) RUB-01 still fails immigration (VAWA + asylum 1-yr bar absent) and family-custody (DV custody factor + flight risk absent); (d) RUB-08 still fails immigration (asylum 1-yr lapse never computed).

DECISION: gates not clear -> 8-persona expansion NOT run (policy 5) and no further fix iteration this round; fixes go to the next round with Damien. The 5 expansion personas remain authored + committed with verified-law answer keys.

sections.title: Bugs found and FIXED this campaign (deployed to dev)
sections.body_html:
Fixed and deployed to Railway alea-intake-dev this campaign:

  • BUG-3 — dev LLM key/model misconfigured; added Railway vars + new ALEA_LLM_PROVIDER/ALEA_LLM_MODEL/ALEA_LLM_API_KEY env overrides, set to gpt-4o-mini per policy 5.
  • BUG-4 — LLM client called with the wrong API shape at every seam (positional messages args; calls to a nonexistent LLMService.json_async that raised AttributeError, silently swallowed).
  • BUG-6 — OpenAI JSON-mode's "contains the word 'json'" requirement was unmet, killing the gap and question-generation stages outright.
  • BUG-7 — extraction prompt never named the schema fields, so pydantic validation rejected every extracted fact (0 facts extracted, forever).
  • BUG-8 — exploration stage ran on 0 facts and fabricated generic claims, then re-ran on every iteration (133 spam claims/persona). Fixed: once-per-run execution + name-based dedupe + no-facts guard.
  • BUG-9 — shared.folio_embeddings was never provisioned (ensure_table never called, no shared schema), so the resolver cascade died at stage 1. Fixed with graceful per-stage degradation. Related startup fix: moved index build off the boot critical path (it was killing the healthcheck / deploys) and batched the upserts (18,325 vectors indexed in 48s).
  • BUG-10 — code assumed a dict contract against folio-python's actual List[OWLClass] return type (build_index, _determine_branch, adjacency traversal).
  • BUG-11 — search_by_label returns (OWLClass, score) tuples, not bare objects; the label-resolution stage crashed on this and silently zeroed ALL IRIs. Also fixed in this pass: issue_spot per-run claim dedupe (was emitting 'Nonpayment of Rent' x3).
  • BUG-5 — downgraded: turned out to be a harness JSON-export misreport, not a pipeline bug.

Meta-finding: three unit test fixtures encoded the wrong contracts (a positional chat_async assertion, dict-shaped classes, a bare-object search_by_label stub) — unit-green, integration-dead. The fixtures matched the code's wrong assumptions, not the real dependency's behavior.

Round 2 (session 4, commits e559f0b..682039e, deployed):

  • BUG-12 — deadline today-anchor + self-dated hearing/deadline rules with citations. Verified live: RUB-09 passes on all 3 personas; RUB-08 on 2 of 3; all answer-key date math correct, no 2023 mis-anchoring.
  • BUG-13 — placeholder-concept filter. Partial: 'ZZZ - SANDBOX' gone, but geographic ('Macedonia', 'Europe', 'Rize') and cross-domain litigation concepts ('Markman Hearing') still surface as claims -> superseded by BUG-21.
  • BUG-14 — question/claim-section dedup. Partial: question dupes gone (10/0/8 unique questions), but element-fact lines still repeat 9-37x inside memo sections.
  • BUG-15 — decoupled safety pass. Live: family-custody memos open with a calm, well-toned safety section (judge: 'tone is genuinely good'); but the resource list is domain-mismatched -> BUG-20.
  • BUG-16 — question_gen silent zero now logged/observable (immigration still returns 0 questions; not answer-key-gated).
  • GATE-01 latent-issue coverage in issue_spot. Partial: landlord-tenant now passes RUB-01 (both gate issues surfaced); immigration + family-custody still fail on narrower grounds.
  • q10 — top-7-grouped memo claim display. Partial: show-more overflow + 'Related to:' grouping exist, but 11-14 full sections render instead of 7 and grouping is inconsistent.
  • Rubric v1.2 locked (Damien amendment: RUB-05 semantic-fit sub-criterion) + CE-review hardening (682039e).

sections.title: Bugs found, OPEN (next iteration)
sections.body_html:
Open after re-judge vs v1.2 (evidence in per-persona scorecards; all quotes verifiable in runs/*/):

  • BUG-18 [GATE RUB-15, all 3 personas] — JSON export payload is an empty shell on every profile: "claims_by_jurisdiction": {}, "deadlines": [], "action_items": [], "executive_summary": "", gap_report zeroed — vs 21-25 claims / 3-4 deadlines on screen. PDFs round-trip fine. Latent since round 1 (export_50.json is also empty); session-3 exports_ok checked only HTTP/magic/nonzero, so it was missed. Verified across all 10 JSON exports.
  • BUG-21 [GATE RUB-05 v1.2, all 3 personas] — semantically wrong FOLIO mappings surfaced with false confidence (supersedes BUG-13 residue): 'Failure to Provide Habitable Living Conditions' -> Living (vital status, 90%); 'Claim for Rent Withholding' -> Insurance Claims (which spawned motorist/no-fault/SSA junk claims + a product-liability question to an eviction client); 'Retaliatory Behavior' -> Lease (85%); 'Unauthorized Employment Concerns' -> Rize, a Turkish city (85%); patent Markman Hearing URGENT-flagged to a pro-se immigration client; Macedonia / Europe surfaced as URGENT potential claims in family-custody. Needs semantic-similarity gating between claim text and concept definition, not just resolvability + placeholder filtering.
  • BUG-19 — leaked rewriter error string shipped as claim Conclusions in memos AND exported PDFs: 'It seems there was an issue with the text provided. Please provide the legal text you'd like rewritten.' (16x memo_56, 10+x memo_59, also memo_51/53). LanguageAdapter failure text is written into the document instead of falling back to the original.
  • BUG-20 — safety resource list domain-mismatched: family-custody DV memo lists SPARC (stalking) + two immigration orgs (NIWAP, Immigration Advocates Network) and omits the National DV Hotline 1-800-799-7233 while its own text promises 'reachable through the hotline above'; landlord-tenant memo_52 gets a safety banner despite safety_alerts=0 (wrong-domain template contamination).
  • RUB-01 residuals [GATE, 2 personas] — immigration: VAWA self-petition never raised (married to LPR + battery in narrative), asylum 1-yr bar never surfaced/computed (entry 2019 -> lapsed Aug 14, 2020). family-custody: § 518.17 DV custody factor never connected to the Jun 28 incident; abduction threat mapped to 'Parental Alienation' instead of flight-risk; custody misframed as 'Modification' (no prior order exists).
  • Primary-source grounding still absent — every claim: 'No authorities identified for this claim.'; deadline citations self-referential (stated_court_date, generic_notice_window), jurisdiction 'US'/null, never resolved to a state. RUB-09 passes only because nothing wrong is asserted; RUB-LT-16-style addendum gates read this stricter — flag for Damien.
  • BUG-14 residue — element-fact lines repeat 9-37x per memo section (dedup fixed questions/sections, not element fact-links).
  • q10 residue — 11-14 full claim sections render vs top-7; adjacency children inconsistently grouped; ordering ignores confidence.
  • BUG-17 — memo/run traceability (round-1 finding) not re-verified this round.
  • RUB-10 — plain-language FK grade 12.4-17.0 vs ~6 target on court_self_help/legal_aid profiles (adapter wired but ineffective; related to BUG-19 failures).
  • questions=0 on immigration (40 open gaps, 0 questions) — observable now (BUG-16) but still the wrong answer; forfeits RUB-13/RUB-IMM-11.

sections.title: Deterministic sidecars (memo_checks.py + folio_check.py)
sections.body:
Re-run (runs 26/27/28): folio_check.py --all: 65/65 claim IRIs resolve + non-deprecated + rooted to owl:Thing (deterministic; but see BUG-21 — resolvability is not semantic fit, and 4 claims across IMM/LT carry no IRI at all).
memo_checks.py: exports_ok=True on all 9 memos (HTTP/magic/content-type/nonzero only — this check is now known-shallow: it missed BUG-18's empty JSON payloads; extend it to assert claims_by_jurisdiction/deadlines/executive_summary non-empty next round).

sections.title: What v1.0 UAT close still needs (after round 2)
sections.body_html:
Four blockers stand between this campaign and gate-clear (then the 8-persona expansion runs):

  1. BUG-18 — wire the real analysis payload into the JSON exporter (RUB-15, all personas; PDFs already correct).
  2. BUG-21 — semantic-fit gating on surfaced FOLIO mappings (RUB-05 v1.2, all personas): score claim-text vs concept-definition similarity, drop/flag mismatches instead of surfacing at 70-90% confidence.
  3. RUB-01 depth — latent doctrine coverage for immigration (VAWA, asylum 1-yr bar with lapse computation) and family-custody (DV custody factor, flight risk); likely prompt-level issue-spot with practice-area doctrine checklists.
  4. RUB-08 immigration — compute lapsed/expired deadlines too (asylum 1-yr bar), not just future ones.

Non-gate but shipped-document-quality: BUG-19 (leaked error text in client PDFs), BUG-20 (wrong-domain safety resources; missing DV hotline), BUG-14/q10 residue, RUB-10 reading level, primary-source citations (Damien to rule on strict addendum reading of RUB-LT-16).

Decision rule honored: gates not clear -> expansion NOT run, no further unsupervised fix iteration; fixes above go to the next round with Damien via this pack's EP-IDs.
